# Asia Open Briefing: Supply Tight, Prices Rising Across Analog Portfolio  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter lead times and higher pricing; lock in key analog parts now, but hold on neutral‑risk MOSFETs.

## What changed
- Market supply risk nudged up to **71.9** (+0.1) and price trend stays high at **82.0** (no change) [1].  
- Processor & advanced‑logic segment supply risk rose to **71.9** (↑0.1) with price trend **79.4** [2].  
- Memory segment price trend lifted to **73.6** driven by a **+15.5 % QoQ** DRAM contract price outlook [3].  
- Analog & power‑management segment price trend **76.9**, supply risk **69.3** (stable) [4].  
- Korea chip‑led export volume jumped **+100 % YoY** in early Nov, reinforcing demand pressure on both supply and price [5].

- **Chip prices next 3 mo:** 66 % chance of rise, expected **+2.17 %** (80 % range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑tested edge.
